correctness.rationale: The fixed consecutive edges give total reachability at every time; a finite linear order has a contractible Alexandrov topology under either convention. In a four-vertex block the prebirth and active states have no invariant two-path: each possible one has a distinct missing shortcut face. The active cycle is the fundamental cycle of the long chord. After death the two invariant triangles have boundaries -Cz and Cz-G, where Cz is the fundamental cycle of the new short chord and G is the active long-chord cycle. The change of basis is unimodular, so the two boundaries exhaust the integral cycle lattice and have no kernel. The only local three-path has a forbidden face. For a path crossing an articulation, deleting the articulation produces a face with an illegal consecutive pair; the only way to repair that pair by inserting a vertex is to reinsert that articulation, so this coefficient cannot cancel. This rules out crossing invariant chains, and the cycle lattices glue by direct sum at the common vertices. The actual chain G is unchanged by other insertions and becomes a boundary at its prescribed death. The argument works directly over fields too; it does not assume arbitrary path-chain base change. It covers simultaneous endpoints, birth at zero, infinite deaths and the empty barcode. The supplied rational rank test is finite and was inspected, not rerun or used for integrality.
residual_risks: No minimum vertex count, arbitrary integral interval-module extensions, or higher-degree realization theorem is established.

value.rationale: For users comparing directed persistence and reachability, a known isolated discrepancy cannot say what fixed reachability constrains. The result removes that constraint on every finite degree-one barcode while keeping a contractible vertex topology and no higher homology, and gives an explicit integral model that distinguishes actual persistence maps from rank-only examples.
residual_risks: This is a realization/obstruction-to-inference result, not a stability, minimality, or data-analysis performance result.
